timing_contract.caller_rtt: F32LE input serialization start through owned contiguous F32 output copy completion; same serializer, OwnedPipeWorker.request, response prefix parse, and NumPy owned copy for CPU and Arc
timing_contract.worker_wall: Service-local input owned copy through native operator/full graph and output serialization; CPU and Arc reported separately
timing_contract.run42_comparison_note: Fresh Arc remeasure required: run42 timed input SHA/monitor checks in its client RTT.
timing_contract.paired_end_barrier: Same reusable two-party barrier is entered after both end timestamps/output copies and before any monitor/hash/quality/file-write postprocessing.
timing_contract.output_persistence: Each raw response is written exclusively under the E private root after the timed boundary; size/hash/path are in the receipt before numerical gating.
